question.text: If a call option's delta is 0.30, a Re 1 increase in the underlying will cause the premium to increase by approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Delta of 0.30 means that a 1-unit move in the underlying causes about a 0.30 move in the option premium. So a Re 1 rise in the underlying lifts the premium by approximately Rs. 0.30. The Trap: Delta is a sensitivity ratio in the range 0 to 1 (in absolute value), not a fixed rupee amount or a percentage of the underlying. Note: The delta-based premium move (delta 0.30 causing about a 0.30 premium change for a 1-point underlying move) is supported by page 73 of the NISM Series-I workbook.
